messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The Evanstonian is an upscale independent hotel. When a guest calls room service at The Evanstonian, the room-service manager takes down the order. She then submits an order ticket to the kitchen to begin preparing the food. She also gives an order to the sommelier (i.e., the wine waiter) to fetch wine from the cellar and to prepare any other alcoholic beverages. Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or some other alcoholic beverage. Finally, she assigns the order to the waiter. While the kitchen and the sommelier are doing their tasks, the waiter readies a cart (i.e., puts a tablecloth on the cart and gathers silverware). The waiter is also responsible for nonalcoholic drinks. Once the food, wine, and cart are ready, the waiter delivers it to the guest ’ s room. After returning to the room-service station, the waiter debits the guest ’ s account. The waiter may wait to do the billing if he has another order to prepare or deliver.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="RoomServiceProcess" name="The Evanstonian Room Service Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Call" name="Guest Calls Room Service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Call" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take Down Order" resourceRole="Room-Service Manager">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Split" name="Split Tasks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Kitchen</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sommelier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Waiter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Gateway_Split" />

    <!-- Kitchen Lane -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-Service Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WineCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NoWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NonAlcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deliver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Complete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Kitchen Task -->
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare Food">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Kitchen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FoodReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Kitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FoodReady" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />

    <!-- Sommelier Lane -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WineCheck" name="Includes Alcohol?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sommelier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_YesWine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoWine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sommelier" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Gateway_WineCheck" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesWine" name="Yes (80%)" sourceRef="Gateway_WineCheck" targetRef="Task_PrepareWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareWine" name="Fetch Wine & Prepare Beverages">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_YesWine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WineReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WineReady" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWine" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoWine" name="No (20%)" sourceRef="Gateway_WineCheck" targetRef="Task_NoWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NoWine" name="No Action Required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoWine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoWineDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoWineDone" sourceRef="Task_NoWine" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />

    <!-- Waiter Lane -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignOrder" name="Assign Order to Waiter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Waiter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Waiter" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_AssignOrder" />
    
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterSplit" name="Waiter Parallel Start">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cart</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Drinks</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCart" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrder" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterSplit" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready Cart (Tablecloth, Silverware)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CartDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CartDone" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterMerge" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NonAlcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare Non-Alcoholic Drinks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Drinks</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinksDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drinks" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterSplit" targetRef="Task_NonAlcoholicDrinks" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinksDone" sourceRef="Task_NonAlcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterMerge" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterMerge" name="Waiter Ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CartDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinksDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WaiterReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterReady" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />

    <!-- Join Gateway -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join" name="All Components Ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FoodReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WineReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoWineDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WaiterReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDeliver</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deliver" name="Deliver to Guest's Room">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDeliver</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDeliver" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Task_Deliver" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return" sourceRef="Task_Deliver" targetRef="Gateway_BillingCheck" />

    <!-- Billing Logic -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingCheck" name="Another Order Pending?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DoBilling</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DeferBilling</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DoBilling" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingCheck" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeferBilling" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Debit Guest's Account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DoBilling</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Process Complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DeferBilling</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
